title: Create or join a room
body: Start from Home. Choose a restaurant and invite your group, or join a room using its link or code.

title: Choose together
body: Everyone sees the same live selection and result. Quick Choice in More also picks names for games, tasks, or any reason.

title: Keep payments clear
body: The Wallet tab shows your balance, payments and approvals. Open a wallet to see its transactions, or settle payments from a room.

title: Bring your group
body: Find Groups in More. Add people, manage members, and invite a saved group when creating a room.

title: Take the next action
body: Open the bell for invitations and payment requests. Act from the notification center, mark all as read, or clear the inbox.

title: Make it yours
body: Open Profile for your name, payment details, language and notification preferences. You are ready to get started!
